profile_template:
(version 1)
(deny default)
(allow process-exec (literal "/opt/homebrew/Cellar/python@3.12/3.12.13_4/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/bin/python3.12") (literal "/opt/homebrew/Cellar/python@3.12/3.12.13_4/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/Resources/Python.app/Contents/MacOS/Python"))
(allow sysctl-read
      (sysctl-name-prefix "kern.os")
      (sysctl-name-prefix "kern.version")
      (sysctl-name "kern.maxfilesperproc")
      (sysctl-name "kern.maxfiles")
      (sysctl-name "machdep.cpu.brand_string"))
(allow file-read-metadata
      (subpath "<temporary-work-dir>")
      (literal "/opt")
      (literal "/opt/homebrew")
      (literal "/opt/homebrew/Cellar")
      (subpath "/opt/homebrew/Cellar/python@3.12")
      (subpath "/System/Library")
      (subpath "/usr/lib")
      (literal "/")
      (literal "/dev/null"))
(allow file-read* (subpath "/opt/homebrew/Cellar/python@3.12") (subpath "/System/Library") (subpath "/usr/lib") (subpath "/usr/share") (subpath "<temporary-work-dir>") (literal "/") (literal "/dev/null")
      (literal "/dev/random") (literal "/dev/urandom"))
(allow file-write* (subpath "<temporary-work-dir>") (literal "/dev/null"))
(deny process-info*)
